upstream.text: an input of the operation is not defined; the state is the worst state of the inputs, cause names the root element

no_intersection.text: the objects have no common point

branch_absent.text: fewer solutions than the slot number

outside_part.text: the point of the slot lies outside the arc, segment, ray or sector

parallel.text: the lines are parallel and distinct

coincident.text: the objects coincide; there are infinitely many common points

zero_length.text: the direction of a zero-length segment or vector is required

point_inside.text: a tangent from a point inside the circle or conic

not_on_curve.text: the point has to lie on the curve

index_out_of_range.text: the vertex or root number is out of range

out_of_domain.text: the function value is outside its domain or complex

no_root_in_window.text: no root or extremum found in the search window

non_finite.text: the result contains NaN or an infinity (any operation)

invalid_parameter.text: an input number is outside the allowed range

not_dependent.text: the traced point does not depend on the mover of the locus (registry 1.5)

empty_range.text: the parameter window of the locus mover is empty (registry 1.5)

unknown_op.text: the operation is not in this registry version

unsupported_signature.text: the operation exists but this combination of input types is not implemented

newer_registry.text: the document needs a newer registry than this library

dangling_ref.text: a reference to an element that does not exist

type_mismatch.text: the element type does not fit the slot

formula.text: an expression outside the whitelist, depth or length, or a text template with a bad insert

limit_exceeded.text: a limit on elements, samples or time is exceeded

internal.text: an exception in the implementation (any operation); see diagnostics
